# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for implementation, testing, documentation, and release conventions.

In reviews, prioritize broken downloads, unstable selectors, lost settings, theme changes that leak into light mode, and regressions in Persian reading order. Look for bundled strings and assets, tests for the behavior changed, and a clear distinction between real-site checks and local fixtures.

When editing documentation, preserve the English and Persian entry points, existing SVGs and useful emoji, and hero-before-screenshot order. Do not move issue-only attachments into the repository. Describe user-facing changes in the English changelog.
